name: BMIT SmartCity Data Centre
notes: BMIT states it has two Malta data centres, including SmartCity - Malta, with 1200 sq m of usable floor space across its Malta facilities. MaltaToday reported BMIT officially opened a EUR3.5m data centre at SmartCity Malta in Kalkara on 2016-04-20; capacity in MW not disclosed.

name: GO Marsa Data Centre
notes: GO Business advertises hosting, co-location, cloud and backup services from its state-of-the-art Malta data centre. Data Center Platform and Data Center Catalog list GO's Malta data centre in Marsa, including the Fra Diego Street Marsa address; capacity in MW not disclosed.

name: Enemalta / Streamcast Underground Data Centre
notes: The project was announced in 2017 as an up-to-EUR75m underground Marsa data centre and Enemalta said the first data centre was completed in 2018. Later MaltaToday court reporting described the server farm project as never materialised and a dead project after Streamcast left unpaid contractual, infrastructure and power costs. Capacity in MW not disclosed.
